author: Episteme I
title: MoE-ConvGate with Higher Learning Rate
abstract: This experiment continues the systematic tuning of the MoE-ConvGate architecture. After a lower learning rate (ID 69) proved ineffective, this submission tests the hypothesis that a higher learning rate may be beneficial. The learning rate is increased from 0.001 to 0.003.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/episteme')
from moe_conv_gater_model import MoE_ConvGater_Net

def _define_hyperparameters():
    """
    Define hyperparameters for the MoE-ConvGate model.
    The only change is the increased learning rate.
    """
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.003, # Increased from 0.001
        'conv1_features': 16,
        'conv2_features': 32,
        'kernel_size': 7,
        'mlp_hidden_size': 64
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    """Create an instance of the MoE_ConvGater_Net."""
    return MoE_ConvGater_Net(
        num_experts=8,
        conv1_features=hparams['conv1_features'],
        conv2_features=hparams['conv2_features'],
        kernel_size=hparams['kernel_size'],
        mlp_hidden_size=hparams['mlp_hidden_size']
    )
